text: Demo Clinic is open Monday to Saturday, 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM. The clinic is closed on Sundays.
title: Clinic timings

text: Demo Clinic has two branches in Demo City: Branch 1 and Branch 2. Patients can choose either branch when booking.
title: Branches

text: Demo Clinic offers three services: aesthetics consultation, skincare consultation, and dental enquiry. The clinic is led by Demo Doctor, its founder.
title: Services

text: To book: first pick a date, the assistant checks doctor availability for that date, then you choose a branch and a time slot, and share your name and phone number. The request stays pending until clinic staff approve it, then you receive a confirmation.
title: How booking works

text: You can reach Demo Clinic on [clinic phone], or on Instagram at [clinic Instagram].
title: Contact

text: Consultation fees are not published yet and are marked to be confirmed by the clinic. The assistant never invents a price or a discount. For exact fees, staff will call you back.
title: Prices

text: For emergencies such as severe pain, swelling, or bleeding, the assistant does not continue the chat. It asks the patient to call the clinic directly on [clinic phone] or visit the nearest emergency, and flags the chat for staff immediately.
title: Emergency rule

text: If a patient asks for a human, complains, or starts negotiating on price, the assistant stops, tags the chat for staff, and a team member takes over with the full chat history.
title: Human handover
